Ben Oldman Partners (33%){{cite news |title=Solares se reúne en Querétaro para comprar Gallos Blancos a la espera de su llegada a Valladolid|url=https://www.eldesmarque.com/futbol/real-valladolid/20250604/gabriel-solares-reunion-gobernador-queretaro-comprar-gallos-blancos-espera-llegada-pucela_300684294.html |access-date=2 July 2025 |publisher=El Desmarque}} | chairman = Gabriel Solares | chrtitle = President | manager = [[Fran Escribá]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | league = {{Spanish football updater|Valladolid}} | season = {{Spanish football updater|Valladolid2}} | position = {{Spanish football updater|Valladolid3}} | website = {{URL|https://www.realvalladolid.es/|realvalladolid.es}} | pattern_la1 = _valladolid2526h | pattern_b1 = _valladolid2526h | pattern_ra1 = _valladolid2526h | pattern_sh1 = _valladolid2526h | pattern_so1 = _valladolid2526hl | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | body1 = FFFFFF | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = FFFFFF | pattern_la2 = _valladolid2526a | pattern_b2 = _valladolid2526a | pattern_ra2 = _valladolid2526a | pattern_sh2 = _valladolid2526a | pattern_so2 = _valladolid2526al | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 | pattern_la3 = _valladolid2526t | pattern_b3 = _valladolid2526t | pattern_ra3 = _valladolid2526t | pattern_sh3 = _valladolid2526t | pattern_so3 = _valladolid2526tl | leftarm3 = ffd63c | body3 = ffd63c | rightarm3 = ffd63c | shorts3 = ffd63c | socks3 = ffd63c | current = 2025–26 Real Valladolid season }} '''Real Valladolid Club de Fútbol, S.A.D.''', or simply '''Real Valladolid''' ({{IPA|es|reˈal βaʎaðoˈlið|pron}}), is a Spanish professional [[association football|football club]] based in [[Valladolid]], [[Castile and León]]. The club competes in the {{Spanish football updater|Valladolid}}, the second tier of Spanish professional football. The club colours are violet and white, used on the kit in stripes from its foundation on 20 June 1928.{{Cite web|url=https://muckrack.com/liveleganes-vs-valladolid-live-stream-1/bio|title=Liga española de futbol. Real Valladolid {{!}} El Norte de Castilla|date=18 December 2008|access-date=2020-02-03|archive-date=13 June 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200613155300/https://muckrack.com/liveleganes-vs-valladolid-live-stream-1/bio|url-status=dead}} The team plays its home games at the [[Estadio José Zorrilla]], which seats 27,846 spectators.{{Cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/events/351772739130439/|title=Pechincha: Ronaldo negocia para comprar estádio que já recebeu Copa para seu time; veja o preço|date=11 October 2019|website=ESPN.com|language=pt|access-date=2020-01-24}} Valladolid's honours include a single trophy of great relevance, the defunct [[1984 Copa de la Liga|Copa de la Liga 1983–84]]. It has been runner-up in the Copa del Rey on two occasions ([[1949–50 Copa del Generalísimo|1949–50]] and [[1988–89 Copa del Rey|1988–89]]), and has participated in two editions of the [[UEFA Cup]] ([[1984–85 UEFA Cup|1984–85]] and [[1997–98 UEFA Cup|1997–98]]) and also one edition of the [[UEFA Cup Winners' Cup]] ([[1989–90 European Cup Winners' Cup|1989–90]]). The team subsidiary, the [[Real Valladolid Promesas]], currently play in the [[Segunda Federación]]. Since its La Liga debut in the 1948–49 season (in which it became the first club from the region to play in La Liga – five others have since done so), Valladolid is the most successful football club in Castile and León by honours and history, with a total of 47 seasons in the First Division, 36 in the Second and 10 in the Third.{{Cite web|url=https://www.djournal.com/calendar/leganes-vs-valladolid---live-stream/event_343021b0-ad8a-11ea-bf38-5cb9017bff17.html|title=Real Valladolid – Primera División|website=www.resultados-futbol.com|access-date=2020-02-03|archive-date=13 June 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200613165107/https://www.djournal.com/calendar/leganes-vs-valladolid---live-stream/event_343021b0-ad8a-11ea-bf38-5cb9017bff17.html|url-status=dead}} Historically, Valladolid is the 13th-best team in Spain by overall league points. Two of its players have won the Pichichi Trophy: [[Manuel Badenes]] and [[Jorge Orosmán da Silva|Jorge da Silva]]; and ten were internationals with the [[Spain men's national football team|Spain national football team]]. In the 21st century, the club's domestic performance follows a [[yo-yo club]] pattern, with multiple promotions to (and relegations from) the first division. On 3 September 2018, it was announced that Brazilian former international footballer [[Ronaldo (Brazilian footballer)|Ronaldo Nazario]] had become the majority shareholder after purchasing a 51% controlling stake in the club.{{cite news| url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/45397137| title=Ronaldo: Former Brazil striker buys controlling stake in Real Valladolid| work=BBC Sport| date=3 September 2018| access-date=3 September 2018}} In 2025, Nazario sold the controlling stake to Grupo Ignite."}}
